title: smime-tree: lib.rs has no crate-level documentation — docs.rs shows nothing
description: smime-tree/src/lib.rs has only module declarations and pub use re-exports; no //\! crate-level doc comment. Consequence: docs.rs renders a blank crate overview; cargo doc --open shows no description, no usage example, no list of operations. Users arriving at crates.io documentation cannot understand what the crate does without reading the README or CLAUDE.md.
